rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent linear/bar-derived mass with a carved internal void, so it clears the basic one-gesture test and supports the neighborhood-living brief better than a generic sealed box. The green parcel is respected and the form does not appear to spill outside it. The thick blue access edge is answered, but only moderately: the building’s open/void response is present more as an internal courtyard-like subtraction than as a strongly legible public threshold on the access edge. In multiple views the mass remains consistent and not visibly colliding, which supports repair integrity. The silhouette is somewhat stepped/terraced but not to the point of becoming arbitrary cake-tiering; it is a coherent ribbon/slot composition. Programmatically it can plausibly host a compact mixed-use neighborhood building, though it would benefit from a clearer ground-level public seam and more explicit section/roof articulation.
